'购货订单' as node_name, 'pur_order' as bill_type, purchase_order_id as bill_id, purchase_order_no as bill_no, business_date, total_amount as amount, status, biz_status, source_bill_type, source_bill_id, source_bill_no, '采购源单' as relation_label, create_by, create_time from pur_order union all select 'warehouse' as node_type, '出库单' as node_name, 'outbound' as bill_type, outbound_id as bill_id, outbound_no as bill_no, business_date, total_amount as amount, status, biz_status, source_bill_type, source_bill_id, source_bill_no, '下游出库' as relation_label, create_by, create_time from wms_outbound union all select 'warehouse' as node_type, '入库单' as node_name, 'inbound' as bill_type, inbound_id as bill_id, inbound_no as bill_no, business_date, total_amount as amount, status, biz_status, source_bill_type, source_bill_id, source_bill_no, '下游入库' as relation_label, create_by, create_time from wms_inbound union all select 'invoice' as node_type, case when invoice_type = 'purchase' then '采购发票' else '销售发票' end as node_name, 'invoice' as bill_type, invoice_id as bill_id, invoice_no as bill_no, business_date, invoice_amount as amount, status, biz_status, source_bill_type, source_bill_id, source_bill_no, '发票登记' as relation_label, create_by, create_time from fin_invoice union all select 'finance' as node_type, '应收单' as node_name, 'receivable' as bill_type, receivable_id as bill_id, receivable_no as bill_no, business_date, amount, status, biz_status, source_bill_type, source_bill_id, source_bill_no, '应收往来' as relation_label, create_by, create_time from fin_receivable union all select 'finance' as node_type, '应付单' as node_name, 'payable' as bill_type, payable_id as bill_id, payable_no as bill_no, business_date, amount, status, biz_status, source_bill_type, source_bill_id, source_bill_no, '应付往来' as relation_label, create_by, create_time from fin_payable union all select 'finance' as node_type, '收款单' as node_name, 'receipt' as bill_type, receipt_id as bill_id, receipt_no as bill_no, receipt_date as business_date, amount, null as status, null as biz_status, 'receivable' as source_bill_type, receivable_id as source_bill_id, null as source_bill_no, '收款' as relation_label, create_by, create_time from fin_receipt union all select 'finance' as node_type, '付款单' as node_name, 'payment' as bill_type, payment_id as bill_id, payment_no as bill_no, payment_date as business_date, amount, null as status, null as biz_status, 'payable' as source_bill_type, payable_id as source_bill_id, null as source_bill_no, '付款' as relation_label, create_by, create_time from fin_payment union all select 'finance' as node_type, '核销单' as node_name, 'write_off' as bill_type, write_off_id as bill_id, write_off_no as bill_no, write_off_date as business_date, amount, status, null as biz_status, write_off_type as source_bill_type, coalesce(receivable_id, payable_id) as source_bill_id, null as source_bill_no, '核销' as relation_label, create_by, create_time from fin_write_off union all select 'voucher' as node_type, '凭证事件' as node_name, 'voucher_event' as bill_type, voucher_event_id as bill_id, bill_no, event_date as business_date, event_amount as amount, status, voucher_status as biz_status, bill_type as source_bill_type, bill_id as source_bill_id, bill_no as source_bill_no, '凭证' as relation_label, create_by, create_time from fin_voucher_event
mapper.select:
select * from (
) trace_node where (trace_node.bill_type = #{rootBillType} and trace_node.bill_id = #{rootBillId}) or (trace_node.source_bill_type = #{rootBillType} and trace_node.source_bill_id = #{rootBillId}) or (trace_node.source_bill_no is not null and trace_node.source_bill_no = #{rootBillNo}) or ( trace_node.bill_type in ('receipt', 'write_off') and trace_node.source_bill_type in ('receivable', 'receive') and trace_node.source_bill_id in ( select receivable_id from fin_receivable where (source_bill_type = #{rootBillType} and source_bill_id = #{rootBillId}) or (source_bill_no is not null and source_bill_no = #{rootBillNo}) ) ) or ( trace_node.bill_type in ('payment', 'write_off') and trace_node.source_bill_type in ('payable', 'payment') and trace_node.source_bill_id in ( select payable_id from fin_payable where (source_bill_type = #{rootBillType} and source_bill_id = #{rootBillId}) or (source_bill_no is not null and source_bill_no = #{rootBillNo}) ) ) or ( trace_node.bill_type = 'voucher_event' and trace_node.source_bill_type in ('outbound', 'inbound', 'invoice') and trace_node.source_bill_id in ( select outbound_id from wms_outbound where source_bill_type = #{rootBillType} and source_bill_id = #{rootBillId} union all select inbound_id from wms_inbound where source_bill_type = #{rootBillType} and source_bill_id = #{rootBillId} union all select invoice_id from fin_invoice where (source_bill_type = #{rootBillType} and source_bill_id = #{rootBillId}) or (source_bill_no is not null and source_bill_no = #{rootBillNo}) ) ) order by trace_node.business_date asc, trace_node.create_time asc, trace_node.bill_id asc
